AddonSubmissionNode.description: One submitted add-on field from the new form-builder system. Shared shape for new_addons.addons[] and new_addons.pax_addons[].addons[]; children[] nests recursively for conditionally-shown fields.

id.description: This submission row's own id (tour_booking_addon_fields.id) -- unique per answered field, not the field definition.

form_id.description: Which package add-on form (addon_forms.id) this field belongs to.

field_id.description: The field definition (addon_fields.id) this answers -- stable across every booking that uses this form.

field_label.description: The field's label as the traveler actually saw it. Prefer this over field_meta.label for display.

option_id.description: Set only for radio/dropdown fields -- which option was picked.

rule_id.description: Set on the parent field when a rule (evaluated against this field's own answer) controls whether children[] renders.

parent_id.description: The parent node's id, if this field only shows conditionally.

value.description: The raw submitted answer -- "checked" for a checkbox, typed text, or the chosen option's value.

pax_id.description: The exact tour_bookings_transact.id for this traveler's rate group -- the same id as bookingT[].id in v1/booking's response. null on general fields; set on price_per_pax fields. The reliable join key back to v1/booking.

pax_index.description: Opaque per-traveler identity token. null on general fields; set on price_per_pax fields. Do not parse or display -- use person_ordinal instead.

person_ordinal.description: This traveler's 0-based position within their rate group. null on general fields; set on price_per_pax fields.

unit.description: Only meaningful for price_per_unit (the chosen quantity). Always 0 for one_time, always 1 for price_per_pax.

applied_rule_snapshot.description: Frozen at submission time -- stays accurate even if the rule is edited or deleted later.

field_meta.description: The field's CURRENT live definition -- can drift from what the traveler saw if the form was edited since, and is null if the field has since been deleted.

option_meta.description: The chosen option's CURRENT live definition -- same drift/null caveats as field_meta.

transaction.description: Net of any refund, not the original gross charge. null when there is no completed (paid or refunded) transaction for this field -- either it is free, or it is a pay-later add-on still open/unpaid.

field_price.description: Charged when the field itself carries the price.

option_price.description: Charged when the chosen option carries the price.

children.description: Nested dependent fields, same node shape, recursively.

AddonPaxGroup.description: One traveler's add-on answers, grouped from new_addons.pax_addons[].

pax_id.description: The exact tour_bookings_transact.id for this rate group -- the same id as bookingT[].id in v1/booking's response. The reliable join key back to that endpoint's rate groups.

pax_index.description: Opaque per-traveler identity token -- groups this person's rows correctly, but is not a display ordinal.

person_ordinal.description: This traveler's 0-based position within their rate group -- use this for "traveler #N" display and sorting.

addons.description: This traveler's own answers to price_per_pax fields.

data.description: Merges two independent add-ons systems. The legacy fields (tour_package_form_id/tour_booking_id/description/fields) and the new fields (new_addons) are populated independently -- a booking can have either, both, or neither. Use has_old_addons/has_new_addons to branch, not truthiness of fields/new_addons.

tour_package_form_id.description: LEGACY. The retired custom-form definition this submission answered. null when has_old_addons is false.

tour_booking_id.description: LEGACY. Copied from the legacy submission row itself, not the route parameter -- null whenever has_old_addons is false, even on a real booking. Do not use as a general booking-validity check.

description.description: LEGACY. The retired custom form's own description text.

fields.description: LEGACY. The retired custom-form feature's submitted answers -- opaque, no fixed schema; shown here is the shape actually observed in production. null when has_old_addons is false.

description.example: make sure to be on the corner at 7AM

booking_addon_id.description: Vestigial -- always 0, not a real id.

has_old_addons.description: True when the legacy fields above have real data for this booking.

has_new_addons.description: True when new_addons below has real data for this booking.

new_addons.description: NEW. The current form-builder add-ons system. null when has_new_addons is false.

addons.description: Fields answered once for the whole booking (general fields) -- price_per_pax fields are excluded here and appear under pax_addons instead.

pax_addons.description: One entry per traveler who answered a price_per_pax field.

retained_fees.description: Computed at read time, not stored. Card-processing fees left with the operator when a paid add-on was later removed from the booking without that fee being refunded. A finance figure, not for the traveler-facing add-ons UI.
